title: Everything waiting on you is on one page, with a pick for each, from every session
why: Sessions work overnight and park questions; you should answer them all in one sitting, not hunt across threads.
note: Rulings, Oct 26 (shiv, waiting page): item 1 (a) one shared page per project or repo for everything waiting on you, from every session, local too; claude-settings may need two (project threads, local sessions) if they cannot share one, and the build measures that first. Item 2 (a): your own save on a page only you can write counts as your word; needs a rule. Item 3 (a): keep the in-terminal question box, linking to the page. Pilot: https://claude.ai/artifact/9PJB2skRSMtCC4XHvzbmB8 (thread "Answer all waiting decisions in one place", cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2ADTZhQexksM43HTmuCPZMa), items in its own database. Build, one rule plus one skill in claude-settings: a session that defers an item writes it to the page's items collection (id, title, context, options with how, gain and lose, pick, home, owning thread); at its next turn it reads answers/<id>, files the answer in its home and closes the item. Measured Oct 26 (liaison, Mac, from o10): nothing on a page wakes a local session; a save never notifies, and a comment sent to Claude reached the page but auto mode refused the automatic reply. So a session must read the page at its own turns; never wait for a wake. Unmeasured: whether a local session can write to a page's database. Merged in o10 (triage, Oct 26). Port: yes. Placed ahead of c69 (triage, Oct 26): it unblocks every deferred step at once.
